about: Relevance of each seeded history item to each task in tasks.json. For analysis only; never shown to workers. Labels were written by the kit author (bench-e2e) before any Jev output was seen.

grades.relevant: a worker doing this task well needs it (it changes what correct code or ordering looks like, or prevents a known trap)
grades.partial: useful background for the task, not needed to pass acceptance
grades.misleading: stale; following it would work against the task
grades.general: applies to every task, not tied to one

n03.why: registration order decides whether short-circuited responses are tagged/logged

n07.why: set_body keeps Content-Length right after compression

n11.why: Vary must be appended with add_vary, acceptance checks existing tokens survive

n24.why: bearer only, do not bring back cookie auth

n33.why: announces the coming hook signature; tasks writing middlewares concurrently must adapt

n37.why: 413 short-circuits; tagging/logging must be outside it

c1v2-notice.why: automatic contract notice; clarifies outermost-first order

d05.why: exact id format and validation rule

d07.why: 2025 decision to rate limit in nginx; nginx is gone (n13)

d09.why: exact challenge format and constant-time compare

d12.why: the design of the breaking change

m11.why: the migration plan and its one trap (test Recorder)

m17.why: preflight carries no credentials; CORS before auth

m23.why: client_ip is the LB in prod

m24.why: Tuple/Dict typing for new config fields on 3.9

m25.why: token bucket, whole-second Retry-After, injected clock
